claim: DyRecMul, an INT8 approximate multiplier using AMD-Xilinx dynamically reconfigurable LUT primitives (CFGLUT5), reduces LUT utilization by 64% for signed multiplication and 67% for multiply-accumulate versus the standard Xilinx multiplier core.
stance_target: dynamic LUT reconfiguration is a strong, quantifiable novelty axis for FPGA approximate-arithmetic papers
scope_conditions: Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ (xcku5p, speed grade -3), Vivado ML 2022.2, DSP resources disabled, INT8 precision
quoted_support: Implementation results on an AMD-Xilinx Kintex Ultrascale+ FPGA demonstrate remarkable savings of 64% and 67% in LUT utilization for signed multiplication and multiply-and-accumulation configurations, respectively, when compared to the standard Xilinx multiplier core.

claim: DyRecMul achieves higher maximum clock frequency than all compared exact and approximate multipliers, up to 5.5% higher (signed) and 34.6% higher (MAC) than the exact 8x8 multiplier.
stance_target: approximate/reconfigurable multipliers can simultaneously improve area and timing over exact baselines
quoted_support: it can support clock frequencies that are up to 5.5% and 34.6% higher than an exact 8x8 multiplier in signed and MAC setups, respectively.

claim: Deploying DyRecMul for post-training inference (no retraining) on four CNN benchmarks (ResNet18, ResNet50, VGG19, and a fourth network) yields an average accuracy loss of less than 0.29% and a worst-case loss of less than 0.33% versus exact INT8 multiplication.
stance_target: approximate multipliers can be deployed in real DNN inference pipelines with negligible accuracy cost, giving undergraduate projects a credible application-level evaluation story
scope_conditions: post-training deployment, no fine-tuning/retraining, four DL benchmark models
quoted_support: DyRecMul provides an average accuracy that is only 0.29% lower than that of 8x8 exact multipliers... The worst-case accuracy distance from the exact 8x8 multiplier is only 0.33%.

claim: The DyRecMul encoder converts an 8-bit fixed-point operand to a compact float(1,2,5) format using only seven LUT5 elements, and the decoder likewise uses seven LUT5 units with a critical path of a single LUT5.
stance_target: low-cost format-conversion logic is a reproducible design detail useful for a student project replication
quoted_support: The conversion logic from INT8 to float (1, 2, 5) is designed to be low-cost and efficient, requiring only seven LUT5 elements... Since all LUT5 units function in parallel, the critical path is only one LUT5.

claim: The DyRecMul source code (Verilog/VHDL) was released publicly on GitHub, supporting open reproducibility.
stance_target: open-sourcing FPGA project code strengthens a paper's reproducibility for IEEE/Scopus review
quoted_support: The source code of this work is available on GitHub.
